status: MEASURED — supported rows are cross-checked against the registered adapters at runtime. B6-INGEST-002 adds a general intake path: any plausible bureau report (bureau identity plus report-like content) is read and its readable facts extracted, labelled example-backed extraction, never a validated family. This file distinguishes validated presentation families / exact specimens from that general intake, and claims no present-day GB support.

general_intake.accepts: any document that identifies a credit bureau and prints report-like content (accounts, balances, payment status, report dates, collections, inquiries, public records)
general_intake.does_not_require: a known layout, pinned specimen digest, official specimen or exact heading sequence
general_intake.extraction: reference date, account/collection/inquiry/public-record entries with page/line locations, raw values, normalized dates and per-field uncertainty
general_intake.assessments: a general report-fact consistency check (any entry date later than the report's own date); statutory checks stay bound to their own presentations
general_intake.labels: example-backed extraction, never a validated presentation family; no claim of authenticity or universal accuracy
general_intake.refusals: UNRELATED_DOCUMENT for a clearly unrelated document, UNREADABLE_DOCUMENT for a report that could not be read
